evals.prompt: Create a 16x16 exact-grid pixel-art lighthouse in a night storm. It must read at native size, use one warm lantern focal point against cool water, and ship as standalone HTML, editable JSON, and PNG.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained 16x16 artifact whose lighthouse silhouette, directional light, waves, and warm focal cue survive native-scale review.
assertions: The artifact contains index.html, pixel-art.json, and pixel-art.png with exact 16x16 canonical dimensions.
The source spec records projection, light, and focal intent and uses semantic palette roles.
At native 1x a human reviewer identifies a lighthouse without reading the title.
The tower silhouette is shaped rather than left as a plain rectangle, and same-color clusters dominate over accidental single pixels.
The browser proof exposes 1x, 2x, and 4x samples and no remote requests or console errors.

evals.prompt: Convert the supplied full-body character reference into a transparent 32x32 exact pixel master with at most 16 colors. Preserve the pose and oversized red scarf, remove source noise, and provide editable HTML/JSON/PNG proof.
evals.expected_output: A manually cleaned character master derived directly from the source, with a readable pose, intact scarf cue, clean alpha, controlled ramps, and authored clusters.
assertions: Conversion uses contain and targets the original source directly at 32x32.
The final grid is manually repixelized beyond raw quantization: silhouette stair steps, alpha fringe, value groups, and singleton noise are reviewed.
Palette count is at most 16 and the red scarf remains the focal identity cue at native 1x.
The artifact passes deterministic validation and warnings are resolved or explicitly justified with visual evidence.

evals.prompt: Author a reusable 16x16 top-down grass tile and two restrained variants. Keep the palette compact, avoid an obvious repeated landmark, and prove the base plus variants in a repeated 3x3 context before packaging exact-grid outputs.
evals.expected_output: A compact tile collection with seamless edges, coherent repeated cluster grammar, negative space, palette consistency, and browser-visible repetition proof.
assertions: All tile edges loop without seams and every variant preserves the same projection, palette roles, and cluster grammar.
The repeated 3x3 proof has no dominant cross, diagonal, isolated landmark, or busy-on-busy noise.
Motifs or an equally reviewable exact-grid representation reuse cluster topology instead of scattering independent pixels.
Each canonical grid and PNG matches its declared dimensions and the proof HTML remains standalone.

evals.prompt: Author a coherent pack of four transparent 16x16 RPG pickups: health potion, key, shield, and crystal. Share one upper-left light, baseline, padding language, and compact palette roles while keeping every silhouette distinct.
evals.expected_output: A named same-size asset pack with four independently editable exact masters, a standalone overview, distinct native-size reads, and validated PNG parity.
assertions: The pack manifest has kind pack and four unique title-derived item paths even though every master is 16x16.
Every item contains index.html, pixel-art.json, and pixel-art.png and validation proves PNG dimensions and RGBA cells match its canonical grid.
A human reviewer identifies all four items at native 1x without labels and sees one coherent light, baseline, palette-role, and padding system.
The overview is standalone, exposes every item, and links to each exact proof without remote requests or console errors.
